added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Adding an unexpected or prohibited key to a sheet row makes sheet_leaks return a finding.
An empty sheet or detector that permits a planted arm field makes check_sheet return nonzero; sheet-check-mutated.log shows the planted field refused at EXIT=1.

reuse.reason: the comparison script needs the refine call without the bench's own judge; giving run_refine_bench a no-judge mode is a product change outside a measurement node

findings.text: blocking: 120 of 200 blind-sheet rows have an empty source_path, although 80 rows prove the field can be populated; the labeller lacks the DD location required to judge those names against their source.

blocking: 22 arm responses across 14 cases are marked ok with an empty refined_name, so srtj-refine-ab-run.html:42-43 overstates outputs and line 85 wrongly calls all 18 omitted cases model-side failures; correct the accounting before treating the 102-case sheet as a 120-case comparison.
blocking: the per-call result discards token usage and receipts contain no token field, leaving an explicit source-brief deliverable unrecorded.

follow-on: run_arms repeats the refine rendering and structured call owned by imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark_roles.py:616 run_refine_bench, so future changes to that call path must be made twice.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against base 4f73a21af44de4b2e66d70edc5bbd6ffb5b458f0; srtj-refine-ab-run.py builds and runs the arms and the second commit raises the ceiling, adds retries, and rebuilds the 200-row sheet and report.
item_verdicts.done_when: The source brief.md names cohort counts, spend, parse rates, identical outputs, and a planted sheet leak; srtj-refine-ab-run.html reports these and sheet-check-mutated.log records EXIT=1, but the report classifies 14 empty-name cases as model failures.
item_verdicts.goal: The source brief.md requires 120 paired refines and a blind DD-context sheet; srtj-refine-ab-run-results.json records 240 arm calls but srtj-refine-ab-label-sheet.json has 120/200 rows without a source path and covers only 102 paired cases.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md records commits 3923ff4a9dd01db50851fe644c10d96f6b7b0c2a and 39821adb4125105d9a5a0dec9c97abdd248c8d39, both sheet-check logs, and no baseline_suite or after_suite gate.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source brief.md grants four evidence paths; git diff 4f73a21af44de4b2e66d70edc5bbd6ffb5b458f0..39821adb4125105d9a5a0dec9c97abdd248c8d39 changes exactly those four paths.

justifications.durability: srtj-refine-ab-run.py:526-555 and sheet-check-mutated.log guard against leaked fields, but no assertion fails for blank DD paths, empty names counted as outputs, or omitted token counts.
justifications.evidence: sheet-check-mutated.log proves the arm-field guard fires at EXIT=1, but srtj-refine-ab-run.html:42-43 counts empty names as outputs and line 85 attributes 14 such incomplete cases to model-side failures.
justifications.fit: srtj-refine-ab-run.py:231-265 uses the existing review_names owner and line 383 uses build_refine_prompt_context, while the new evidence runner remains separate from production runtime.
justifications.goal_fidelity: srtj-refine-ab-run.py:500 writes an empty source_path in 120 of 200 committed sheet rows, and line 414 discards per-call token data required by the source brief.
justifications.reuse: srtj-refine-ab-run.py:327-464 duplicates refine prompt rendering and structured model calls already owned by imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark_roles.py:616 run_refine_bench rather than extending that execution path.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff from 4f73a21af44de4b2e66d70edc5bbd6ffb5b458f0 to 39821adb4125105d9a5a0dec9c97abdd248c8d39 changes only the four paths named in the source brief.md.
